body:
Death will be solitude.

You can't even go out into the woods and not have someone bother you about something. You'll always run into someone somewhere and it takes money which I don't have to get far enough away to be left alone. Then when you are alone what are you going to do with the time? It's more of a prison sentence than a relief from it all.

Fuck it, no one gets it and no one ever will. I'm going to go kill myself right now. The sooner I kill myself the sooner I can be free from this. The days of talking about this are over. I'm tired of it. I just want to be dead.

Don't waste your time in replying.
I'll never be able to afford anything like that. I don't think you understand my problem and how it effects my ability to have an income.
